title: I Tried to Double $100 With an AI Trading Bot in 22 hours .. Here's What Happened
description:
👉🏻 Learn AI trading bots and algorithmic trading with us:
https://www.skool.com/daviddtech/about

I gave my Claude AI trading bot $100 and one challenge: double the account in 22 hours.

Could an AI trading bot discover its own strategies, test them and trade real money successfully?

Instead of asking Claude to predict the entire market, I gave it one specific task: predict whether the next 15-minute candle would finish higher or lower.

But there was a problem. Winning trades paid less than losing trades cost. Once fees were included, a 50% win rate would lose money.

So before risking the $100, I gave Claude two hours to research and backtest strategies using TradingKit. It tested over 1,600 strategies across more than 34,000 variants, narrowed them down through validation and selected five for live trading.

Then we hit another obstacle: the broker’s up-or-down product had no API available for this setup. Claude built a Chrome extension to automate the trades through my browser.

You’ll see the complete setup, the prompts, the strategy dashboard, the first painful loss, the final trade and the account’s results. Did the AI trading bot actually double my money, or was this another experiment that looked better in a backtest?

## In this video, you’ll discover:

✅ The $100 AI trading bot challenge and its 22-hour target  
✅ How the 15-minute up-or-down trading contracts work  
✅ Why a 50% win rate loses money with this payout structure  
✅ How payouts and fees change the win rate needed to break even  
✅ How to connect Claude to TradingKit for strategy backtesting  
✅ The prompt used to give Claude a two-hour research challenge  
✅ How Claude tested over 1,600 strategies and 34,000 variants  
✅ How testing on unseen historical data helps check for overfitting  
✅ How Claude selected five strategies for the live experiment  
✅ How position sizing changes the account’s risk  
✅ How Claude built the Jarvis Chrome extension for browser-based trading  
✅ The first loss
